seats.name: foreman
seats.description: Plans, splits, judges and escalates; never writes product code

seats.name: builder
seats.description: The only seat that writes product code; hands off evidence packets

seats.name: auditor
seats.description: Reproduces every evidence packet and attacks the changed surface; never edits product code

seats.name: gatekeeper
seats.description: Releases only what builds and starts offline from a fresh clone; never edits code

notes.sandbox: Codex seats need danger-full-access on Windows because the workspace-write sandbox user cannot reach the Jam daemon; the Claude headless seats already run host-native.
notes.spawn_args: Codex memory consolidation injects tasks into app-server sessions; keep it off for seats.
notes.claude_context: Claude subscription auth requires local_config context mode; CLAUDE.md at the repo root pins seats to the mandate.
notes.fallback: All four seats on Codex. Use when Claude subscription access for the CLI is unavailable (seen once, transient, 2026-09-23 22:03 UTC). Single provider weakens the audit; say so in the case study.
